concept: Your body and your belongings are yours — you get to decide who touches or uses them
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character politely but firmly says they don't want to share or be touched in a certain way, and that's respected
exercise.reflection_prompt: Why is it okay for the character to decide this for themselves?
exercise.practice: Student practices a simple, firm, polite way of expressing a personal boundary

assessment.success_marker: student can state a boundary clearly and calmly in the practice roleplay
